# Immutable live-output replay corpus

The 42448389611 directory preserves the exact two submissions and original
unscoreable outcomes from artifact 13605202225. Its manifest records the original
producer and byte digests. Treat these files as immutable data. Never edit a
submission, replace an original outcome with a retrospective grade, or copy this
corpus into a live agent image or skill package.

The correction was developed after inspecting the outputs. Retrospective results
must identify their separate evaluator version and source digests. No result from
this corpus establishes prospectively frozen validation or general skill benefit.
The original native archive and authentication evidence are also retained outside
temporary storage; workflow artifacts retain the same source bindings.
